question: Who is the author of 'The story of My Experiments with Truth'?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**MK Gandhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **MK Gandhi**, also known as **Mahatma Gandhi**, is the author of *The Story of My Experiments with Truth*.
 
• The book is an **autobiography** of Gandhi, detailing his life experiences, principles, and experiments with truth and non-violence.
 
• It was originally written in **Gujarati** and later translated into English and other languages.
